newsitem.title: INDIA: INDIA SUGAR EASES AS FESTIVAL DEMAND DISAPPOINTS.
newsitem.headline: INDIA SUGAR EASES AS FESTIVAL DEMAND DISAPPOINTS.

text.p: Sugar prices turned weak on the local market as millers increased offerings and buying ahead for upcoming festivals was below expectations, dealers said.
Sugar was firm last week ahead of the festivals, but consumer demand in the open market has disappointed sellers due to increased supplies of sugar by government in the public distribution system.
In the ready delivery sugar S-30 slid five rupees to 1,490/1,515 rupees per quintal while M-30 fell by the same margin at 1,510/1,545 rupees.
Sugar mill delivery remained subdued amid poor outstation buying.
In the mill delivery, sugar S-30 fell five rupees to 1,415/1,425 rupees per quintal while sugar M-30 fell by same margin to 1,430/1,445 rupees per quintal.
Overall market sentiment was quiet at the close.
